description: Prose budgets for a feature document, in words. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/feat.md section 6; this file is its machine-checkable half. A budget counts prose words only: fenced code blocks and table rows are free, since examples and reference tables are what a feature document is for. `sections` keys are H2 titles and cover their H3 children; `default` covers any other H2; `exempt` sections are not counted against a section budget but do count toward `document`.
